'''Yadfre''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working in [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a local law enforcement unit. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Yadfre represented the Office of Peace and Security in a panel discussion about the presence of the [[Thaereian military]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Yadfre said little during the debate, and just as the discourse came to an end, he threw up his lunch out of view of the [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]].
